# Spring application security audit

Audit scope: ${input:scope:Service, API or security configuration}

Inspect actual Spring Security configuration and dependency versions. Review authentication, JWT validation, issuer/audience/expiry/signature, key rotation, role mapping, object-level authorization, CORS, CSRF, rate limiting, secrets, sensitive logging, dependency risks and error disclosure.

Provide findings with severity, evidence, attack scenario, remediation and regression test. Identify unverified areas. Do not claim compliance or security certification. Do not modify security controls during the audit.
